SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wow~ it’s been ages since I’ve been here...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哇~这里真是好久没来了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哇～真的好久沒來這裡了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: わ〜、ここ本当に久しぶりだな…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Wah~ sudah lama sekali sejak terakhir kali aku ke sini...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Uau! Faz muito tempo que eu não vinha por aqui...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Guau! hace muchísimo que no venía por aquí…

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我们小时候一拿到零花钱
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 還記得小時候拿到零用錢的話
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 子どもの頃、お小遣いもらうと
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A gente costumava vir sempre que ganhava um dinheirinho,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Solíamos venir aquí cada vez que nos daban dinero,

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 여기 와서 밥 먹고 막 그랬었는데
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: we’d come here every time we got allowance.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 就会跑来这里吃饭来着
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いつもここに来てご飯食べたりしてたよね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: kami akan datang ke sini setiap kali kami mendapat uang saku.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هر بار که کمک هزینه می گرفتیم اینجا می آمدیم.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 근데 너 요즘 왜 이렇게 꾸미고 다니냐?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But hey, why are you so dressed up these days?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过你最近怎么打扮得这么漂亮？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過，你最近怎麼這麼愛打扮啊？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもさ、最近なんかおしゃれしてるけど？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi hei, kenapa kamu berpakaian begitu rapi akhir-akhir ini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas por que você anda se arrumando tanto ultimamente?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Pero por qué te arreglas tanto últimamente?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما هی، چرا این روزها اینقدر لباس پوشیده ای؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t tell me... you got a boyfriend?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你该不会...交男朋友了吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 該不會是…交男朋友了吧？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não me diga que... você tá namorando?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به من نگو... دوست پسر داری؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, what are you talking about~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، در مورد چی حرف میزنی ~

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Well, well, look who it is... huh?
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Wah, wah, lihat siapa itu... hah?

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウ・ユマンとマルスクじゃないんの！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se não são o Yuman e a Malsook!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: We’ll have three orders of tteokbokki, tempura, and sundae, please.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我们要三人份的辣炒年糕、炸物和米肠拼盘
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我們要辣炒年糕炸物米腸，3人份
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: トッポッキ・天ぷら・スンデ3人前で
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kami pesan tiga pesanan tteokbokki, tempura, dan sundae, ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Três porções de tteokbokki com tempurá e macarrão, por favor.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Tres porciones de tteokbokki con tempura y fideos, por favor.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: لطفاً سه سفارش دوکبوکی، تمپورا و سوندائه خواهیم داشت.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Mal-sook, you’ve gotten even prettier, haven’t you?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过末淑是不是更漂亮了？是吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過，末淑又變漂亮了耶？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもマルスク、さらに綺麗になったんじゃない？え？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mal-sook, kamu jadi makin cantik ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, Malsook, você ficou mais bonita.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Oye, Malsook, te has puesto más bonita.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مال‌سوک، تو حتی زیباتر شدی، نه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: So... you two finally got married?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你們該不會是結婚了吧？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: No fim, vocês dois se casaram?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خب... بالاخره شما دوتا ازدواج کردید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You used to complain like crazy!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呦，当初还嚷嚷着不愿意
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哎呦喂，之前還一直喊著討厭對方
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あらまぁ〜、あんなにイヤだって騒いでたのに
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dulu kamu suka sekali mengeluh seperti orang gila!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sempre diziam que não se suportavam...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Siempre decían que no podían ni verse…

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过阿姨早就看出来啦！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもね、私はその頃からわかってたのよ〜！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: tapi aku tahu itu akan terjadi!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas eu já sabia desde então.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero yo ya lo sabía desde entonces.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما من می دانستم که این اتفاق می افتد!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 이 나이가 들면 보이는 게 있거든.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: At my age, you just know these things.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 到了这个年纪自然就懂这些啦
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這把年紀了，有些事是看得出來的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 歳を取るとね、見えるの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Di usiaku, kamu pasti tahu hal-hal ini.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Com a idade, a gente aprende a notar essas coisas.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Con la edad, una aprende a ver esas cosas.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: در سن من، شما فقط این چیزها را می دانید.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 二人、結婚したんでしょ？ ね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu sudah menikah sekarang, kan? Hm?
